standard_prerequisites.name: Ext^0_R(M[1], N) = Ext^{-1}_R(M, N) vanishes for a module M and nonpositive cohomological degree
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the connecting map zero so Ext^1(K', N) injects into Ext^1(K, N).

core_obligations: Set M = Ker(H^{-1}(alpha)); then alpha extends to the distinguished triangle M[1] -> K -> K' -> M[2] (proof lines 22613-22617). Applying Hom(-, N) gives an exact sequence Ext^0_R(M[1], N) -> Ext^1_R(K', N) -> Ext^1_R(K, N), and since Ext^0_R(M[1], N) = Ext^{-1}_R(M, N) = 0 the map Ext^1_R(K', N) -> Ext^1_R(K, N) is injective (proof lines 22618-22625). Any element annihilating Ext^1_R(K, N) therefore annihilates its submodule Ext^1_R(K', N), so condition (1) of the ext-1-annihilated-definite lemma passes from K to K', and the equivalence of (1), (2), (3) transfers the full property (proof lines 22625-22626).
proof_roadmap: Build the distinguished triangle from the kernel of H^{-1}(alpha) (proof lines 22613-22619).
Inject Ext^1(K', N) into Ext^1(K, N) via the long exact sequence and transfer annihilation (proof lines 22620-22631).
difficulty_reason: 16 行、Ext^1-I 零化性质的传递：取 M = Ker(H^{-1}(α))，α 嵌入差三角 M[1] -> K -> K' -> M[2]；Hom(-,N) 的长正合列中 Ext^0(M[1],N)=Ext^{-1}(M,N)=0，故 Ext^1(K',N) 是 Ext^1(K,N) 的子模；I 零化 Ext^1(K,N) 则零化其子模，ext-1-annihilated-definite 引理的等价条件 (1)(2)(3) 随之传递给 K'。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。
